searchText: Hi there! 🫡 I just fixed the CORS error in our frontend app https://kzg-ceremony.party/ but I came accross another problem. We need to set the redirect urls for siwe and github to https://kzg-ceremony.party/signin because right now https://kzg-ceremony-sequencer-dev.fly.dev is redirecting to http://127.0.0.1:3000/auth/callback/ <Grzegorz> summoning Marcin who should be able to allow redirect customization & whitelist your frontend url <Marcin> > <Marcin> Hey, regarding redirect URI customization – you can pass the `redirect_to` param to `auth/request_link`, it will generate links redirecting to any URL, e.g. https://kzg-ceremony-sequencer-dev.fly.dev/auth/request_link?redirect_to=https://kzg-ceremony.party/signin for your redirect. That being said, we still need to whitelist your frontend URL with the auth providers, and I think we must summon @Recmo for that.
